evaluation.feedback: This is a very polished and professional-sounding trap instrumental. I really enjoyed the clean production and the moody atmosphere created by the C minor key. The percussion is crisp, and the subtle vocal stabs give it a high-quality 'type beat' feel. It strikes a great balance between being energetic enough to nod your head to while remaining chill enough for background listening.
evaluation.suggested_prompt: The track works well because of its cohesive mood and layered arrangement. To build on this, try: 'Make a moody trap instrumental in C minor with a catchy synth melody, crisp hi-hat patterns, atmospheric vocal chops, and a prominent but smooth sub-bass.'
